question: If \(991 + 993 + 995\) \(+ 997 + 999\) \(= 5000 - N,\) then \(N = \)
solution:
Five copies of \(1000\) would total \(5000\). The given addends are smaller than \(1000\) by \(9,7,5,3,1\), respectively, so their total falls short of \(5000\) by the sum of these differences:
\[
991+993+995+997+999
=5000-(9+7+5+3+1)
=5000-25.
\]
The question calls this shortfall \(N\), so \(\boxed{N=25}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
